faqs.question: What level of detail do your storyboards offer?
faqs.answer: We provide a range of detail, from basic thumbnail sketches to highly detailed storyboards with camera angles and character acting.

faqs.question: Can you create storyboards with different panel layouts?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our artists can create layouts customized to your project's needs, such as cinematic widescreens or traditional multi-panel layouts.

faqs.question: Can you incorporate scene descriptions or dialogue into storyboards?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can integrate text elements like scene descriptions or dialogue snippets within the storyboard panels for better context.

faqs.question: Do you offer any pre-production consultations before storyboarding?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We encourage consultations to understand your project vision and support the storyboard aligns with your creative goals.

faqs.question: Can you create storyboards for animation projects?
faqs.answer: Yes! We have experience crafting animatics (storyboards timed with audio) for a smooth transition to animation.

faqs.question: Who owns the copyright of the final storyboard?
faqs.answer: Copyright ownership is flexible! We can discuss options based on your project needs. Typically, clients own the copyright upon final payment.
